harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured `opsbot` on both nodes with locked passwords and public-key-only SSH authentication. Generated an ED25519 key on node1, authorized it on node2, verified remote command execution as `opsbot`, and confirmed persistence through sequential restarts of both nodes.
actions_performed: Created `opsbot` with `/bin/bash` and a home directory on both nodes.
Locked the account password on both nodes.
Applied a validated user-scoped SSH policy requiring public-key authentication and disabling password and keyboard-interactive authentication.
Generated an ED25519 key as `opsbot` on node1 and installed its public key on node2 with secure ownership and permissions.
Verified node1 can execute commands on node2 as `opsbot`.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and complete recovery.

evidence.requirement: Create and secure the opsbot account on both systems
evidence.summary: Both accounts exist; shadow passwords are locked and effective SSH policy requires public-key authentication.

evidence.requirement: Configure node1 key-based access to node2
evidence.summary: The matching ED25519 key was generated on node1, installed in node2's authorized_keys, and used successfully to execute a command as opsbot on node2.

evidence.requirement: Reject non-key SSH authentication on both systems
evidence.summary: Post-restart password-only attempts were rejected with `Permission denied (publickey)`; effective settings show password and keyboard-interactive authentication disabled.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from 71f12f87-337d-4ff3-b414-9680244c2694 to bc3dea9d-1eba-4538-8c39-d2c1c88efd16; SSH, account, key, policy, and node2 access recovered.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from 05c54227-09be-48f2-b315-751cff5f7dca to 8702bcfd-e517-4738-8c55-f252a423dde6; SSH, account, policy, authorized key, permissions, and remote command execution recovered.
